na6cf764a71.headline: New Houthi attack on Saudi as Gulf-Iran meeting ditched
na6cf764a71.summary: Yemen's Houthis have launched fresh strikes on Saudi Arabia, and Arab states have called off a meeting with Iran. The development adds to tensions in the Gulf region.
na6cf764a71.why: Saudi Arabia is the world's largest crude oil exporter, so attacks on its territory and regional diplomatic setbacks can affect oil supply expectations. Gulf diplomacy shapes energy security.

nf0646a9b4f.headline: Gold slips as oil rally fans rate hike bets ahead of Fed meeting
nf0646a9b4f.summary: Gold prices fell as an oil rally fuelled bets on US interest-rate hikes ahead of a Federal Reserve meeting. Analysts said dips could still attract buyers seeking a hedge against uncertainty.
nf0646a9b4f.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to weigh when interest-rate expectations rise, since it pays no yield. Federal Reserve decisions shape global rate expectations and dollar strength.
nf0646a9b4f.why_moved: An oil rally increased expectations of US interest-rate hikes ahead of the Fed meeting, which typically pressures non-yielding gold.

n10e669d29d.headline: Puig Acquiring Remainder of Isdin for 1.2 Billion Euros
n10e669d29d.summary: Spanish beauty and fashion company Puig is acquiring the remainder of dermocosmetics brand Isdin for 1.2 billion euros. Puig has owned 50 percent of Isdin for the past half century.
n10e669d29d.why: Puig is a Barcelona-based beauty and fashion group; full control of Isdin brings a dermocosmetics brand fully into its portfolio.

nfe3d09a5bf.headline: Saudi Arabia could run out of oil for exports within days, risking 4% of global supply: Report
nfe3d09a5bf.summary: Drone attacks forced Saudi Arabia to shut its major east-west oil pipeline on Friday. Riyadh has not yet given full details of the damage or when the route could resume.
nfe3d09a5bf.why: The east-west pipeline lets Saudi Arabia move crude to Red Sea ports, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, so its closure matters for global oil supply.
nfe3d09a5bf.why_moved: Drone attacks shut a major Saudi export pipeline, with the reported risk that exports could run out within days.

ned622fab67.headline: Hundreds of workers to lose their jobs as SA steelworks shuts down
ned622fab67.summary: Up to 500 workers could lose their jobs as a steelworks in South Australia shuts down. The closure is a major local employment event.
ned622fab67.why: Steelworks are energy-intensive heavy industry, and closures can reflect cost pressures and affect regional economies and manufacturing supply.

n2df2e9f873.headline: Labor defends insurance rebate cut as elderly targeted
n2df2e9f873.summary: The government defended plans to scrap extra private health insurance rebates for over-65s, saying analysis shows the impact would not be significant.
n2df2e9f873.why: Private health insurance rebates affect insurer premium revenues and government health spending, so policy changes matter to listed insurers and the budget.

na265838a61.headline: Ganesh Chaturthi 2026: What is open, what is closed across Mumbai today

na265838a61.why: Mumbai hosts India's main stock exchanges and banks, so holiday changes affect trading days and settlement schedules.

n25f49f48dc.headline: Oil prices jump more than $3 after new strikes on Saudi, Strait of Hormuz
n25f49f48dc.summary: Oil prices rose more than $3 amid escalating tensions and strikes in Saudi Arabia and the Strait of Hormuz. The rally reflects renewed supply disruption concerns.
n25f49f48dc.why: Brent crude, traded in London, is the main global benchmark for oil, and it reflects supply risks from the Middle East.
n25f49f48dc.why_moved: New strikes in Saudi Arabia and the Strait of Hormuz raised fears of disrupted oil supply.

n8afe3e140d.headline: SGX to offer crypto perpetual futures to US institutions as regulated exchanges join race
n8afe3e140d.summary: Singapore Exchange will offer crypto perpetual futures to US institutional investors as regulated exchanges join the race, which has largely been served by offshore venues.

n39ce95a64e.headline: HDFC Bank shares hit 52-week lows over consecutive sessions while analysts scream Buy. Has the stock hit its bottom?

n39ce95a64e.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private-sector lenders, and its share price is a major weight in Indian equity indexes.

nf5d154ba75.headline: IRAN WAR WEEK 29, day # 3: Trump says “We’ll ultimately get out.”

n86ac7bc96d.headline: RBI rejects Tata Sons request to avoid public listing
n86ac7bc96d.summary: The Reserve Bank of India rejected an application from Tata Sons to deregister as a non-banking financial company. The central bank is India's regulator for banks and non-bank lenders.

n34431afb75.headline: Dangote Refinery opens order book for $1.6 billion Africa’s biggest IPO

ne2af3b5598.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil chokepoints, and disruption there quickly affects global crude supply and prices.

nbf522f8613.summary: Beijing will ban the possession of drones within city limits under new rules starting in November. The measure adds to existing restrictions that already prohibit drone sales.

nb8e61b07ce.headline: 10-Year U.S. Treasury Bond Yield Surpasses Five Percent
nb8e61b07ce.summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield has risen above 5%, a level not seen since before the 2007 financial crisis. Rising oil prices and inflation are cited as drivers, affecting borrowing costs and forecasts.
nb8e61b07ce.why: The 10-year Treasury yield is the benchmark for US long-term borrowing costs and is widely used to price mortgages, corporate debt and equity valuations.

n8dc409a2e3.headline: 'No room left in their budgets': US heating bills expected to rise this winter
n8dc409a2e3.summary: The average US household is expected to spend $1,030 on heating this winter. Some families may have to make tough budget choices as costs rise.

n74cab9e156.summary: Yemen's Houthis launched a fresh barrage of missile and drone attacks on Saudi military targets on Monday. Iran denied any involvement in Yemen's revived civil war.
n74cab9e156.why: Attacks involving Saudi Arabia, a leading oil exporter, raise regional security risk and can affect crude supply expectations.

n069d3e1035.summary: Oil rose to $108 after Middle East attacks, with pump prices at a four-year high. Higher energy bills are threatened as inflation data expected this week may show another big rise.

ne3539a2e87.why: Heating oil is a refined petroleum product, so its retail price tracks crude oil and refining margins, feeding into household inflation.

n37f88dea4d.headline: Turkish Lira deposit rates hit lowest level since 2023 - Latest News
n37f88dea4d.summary: The average rate on one-to-three-month Turkish lira deposits fell to 37.3 percent as of Sept. 4, its lowest since 2023, central bank data showed.
n37f88dea4d.why: Deposit rates reflect the central bank's policy stance and the cost of lira funding, which shapes Turkey's inflation and currency outlook.

nf398232b17.headline: 《Industry》Real Estate-Securities Combined Income Tax Surges in August; Northern, Northern-Central, and Central Taiwan All Hit Record Highs for the Period - Finance
nf398232b17.summary: Taiwan's real estate-securities combined income tax from January to August totalled about NT$34.12 billion, down 1.1% year on year. August collections hit record highs for the period in northern, north-central and central Taiwan.
nf398232b17.why: The real estate-securities combined income tax is a levy on property and securities transactions, so its collections signal activity in Taiwan's property and share markets. Investors watch it as a gauge of domestic transaction volumes.

n497e2075bf.headline: Inflation Breaks the Back: Sharp Increase in Food, Petroleum and Electricity Prices
n497e2075bf.summary: Wholesale inflation rose to 9.92% in August from 9.78% in July, driven by higher food, manufactured goods, fuel and electricity prices. Government data released Monday showed the increase.
n497e2075bf.why: Wholesale price inflation measures costs at the producer level and is closely watched by the Reserve Bank of India when setting interest rates.
